## What we know

- **Name:** 西厂 马厂 (西苑) Xichang, Machang (Xiyuan) (S05, S02, S03, S1207, S20 · confidence A)
- **In English:** The western ground: horse ground and cavalry parade ground (S05, S02, S03, S1207, S20)
- **What it was:** a place outside the walls outside the garden walls (S05, S02, S03, S1207, S20 · confidence A)
- **In 1860:** in use (S05, S02, S03, S1207, S20)
- **Where:** text: west of 畅春园, north of 西花园 (S02 p.107; 日下 j76:36b 'the 马厂 of 西花园' outside 畅春园's 大西门); today's 西苑操场路 (osm way 173346289) runs through it, C; its extent, a circle of 150 m, is assumed (S05, S02, S03, S1207, S20 · confidence C)
- **Note:** 日下 j80:7a: the YMY's water 'from 玉泉山 由西馬厰入進水閘'. S02 pp.21-22: by 1934 the drill ground of the troops at 西苑 covered 畅春园 and 西花园, with barracks; 'the headquarters of the Imperial Guard' of late Qing on its north side (post-1860, not for 1860). Also: today's road name 西苑操场路 (osm way 173346289): the 1909 drill ground, C (Western cavalry parade ground and Military Review Tower), 181 m from the point used.
